msg: Hello, I'm from Hamburg and I'm staying in Bocagrande next week. I'm Open Water certified but my last dive was three years ago. I'd like to dive this Thursday and I fly home on Friday at 10 in the morning. Is that possible?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

A refresher is a great way to get back in the water after a break. Since you’re certified and your last dive was three years ago, you’d book the Refresher, which has the same 18-hour no-fly interval as recreational diving.

For a Thursday daytime dive, activities finish around 12:00–1:00 p.m. You’d need to wait at least 18 hours from your last dive, so a Friday 10:00 a.m. flight would be too soon. Also, departing from Cartagena, the trip returns around 4:15 p.m., so it wouldn’t fit with your Friday flight.

The Refresher from Cartagena is *USD 183 / COP 655,000 online* (the online discount is applied automatically). You can book it here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.
